sql: SELECT count(*) AS programs, count(DISTINCT market_ticker) AS mkts, count(DISTINCT event_ticker) AS events, round(sum(period_reward_usd)::numeric,0) AS pool_usd, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY period_reward_usd)::numeric,0) AS med_pool FROM incentive_programs WHERE superseded_at IS NULL AND disappeared_at IS NULL AND incentive_type='liquidity' AND end_date > now() AND last_seen_at > now() - interval '1 day'
